PROGRAMME LISTING
Science
The Faculty of Science (CUHK Science) was founded in 1963 and comprises six major teaching units: Chemistry, Earth and Environmental Sciences, Life Sciences, Mathematics, Physics and Statistics. With more than half a century of development, CUHK Science is now a world-class, research-oriented Faculty, which attests to the fine levels of research, teaching and learning.
